# aludel v0.4.1 - Table of Contents

> Aludel - LLM Eval Workbench for Phoenix applications

## Pages

- [README](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Contributing to Aludel](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/contributing.md)
- [LICENSE](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Aludel](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.md): Aludel keeps the contexts that define your domain
and business logic.
- [Aludel.DocumentConverter](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.DocumentConverter.md): Converts documents between formats for LLM consumption.
- [Aludel.Evals](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Evals.md): Context for managing evaluation suites, test cases, and runs.

- [Aludel.Evals.AssertionParser](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Evals.AssertionParser.md): Parses and validates assertion payloads from suite editor forms.

- [Aludel.Evals.DocumentIngestion](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Evals.DocumentIngestion.md): Validates and persists uploaded documents for suite test cases.

- [Aludel.Evals.Suite](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Evals.Suite.md): Schema for evaluation test suites.
- [Aludel.Evals.SuiteRun](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Evals.SuiteRun.md): Schema for tracking suite execution results.
- [Aludel.Evals.SuiteRunner](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Evals.SuiteRunner.md): Owns suite execution launch under explicit supervision.

- [Aludel.Evals.TestCase](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Evals.TestCase.md): Schema for individual test cases within a suite.
- [Aludel.Evals.TestCaseDocument](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Evals.TestCaseDocument.md): Schema for file attachments associated with test cases.
- [Aludel.Evals.TestCaseEditor](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Evals.TestCaseEditor.md): Coordinates suite test case editing workflows outside the web layer.

- [Aludel.Execution](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Execution.md): Shared execution boundary for native provider calls and host-app callbacks.

- [Aludel.Executor](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Executor.md): Behaviour and configuration helpers for execution mode dispatch.

- [Aludel.FileValidation](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.FileValidation.md): Validates file content against claimed MIME types using magic bytes.
- [Aludel.Interfaces.Adapters.Http](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.Adapters.Http.md): Generic HTTP client adapter behaviour.

- [Aludel.Interfaces.DocumentConverter.Adapters.Imagemagick](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.DocumentConverter.Adapters.Imagemagick.md): ImageMagick adapter for document conversion.
- [Aludel.Interfaces.DocumentConverter.Behaviour](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.DocumentConverter.Behaviour.md): Behaviour for document conversion adapters.
- [Aludel.Interfaces.LLM.Adapters.Http.Default](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.LLM.Adapters.Http.Default.md): Default LLM HTTP client using ReqLLM.
- [Aludel.Interfaces.LLM.Behaviour](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.LLM.Behaviour.md): Behaviour for LLM provider implementations.
- [Aludel.Interfaces.LLM.Config](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.LLM.Config.md): Configuration utilities for LLM provider implementations.

- [Aludel.Interfaces.LLM.ErrorParser](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.LLM.ErrorParser.md): Shared error parsing logic for LLM provider adapters.
- [Aludel.Interfaces.LLM.Providers.Anthropic](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.LLM.Providers.Anthropic.md): Anthropic Claude API adapter implementation.
- [Aludel.Interfaces.LLM.Providers.Google](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.LLM.Providers.Google.md): Google Gemini LLM provider implementation.
- [Aludel.Interfaces.LLM.Providers.Ollama](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.LLM.Providers.Ollama.md): Ollama API adapter implementation.
- [Aludel.Interfaces.LLM.Providers.OpenAI](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.LLM.Providers.OpenAI.md): OpenAI LLM provider implementation.
- [Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Adapters.AWS](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Adapters.AWS.md): AWS S3-backed document storage adapter.

- [Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Adapters.AWS.Client](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Adapters.AWS.Client.md): Behaviour for the AWS storage adapter's S3 client boundary.

- [Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Adapters.AWS.ExAwsClient](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Adapters.AWS.ExAwsClient.md): Default AWS client implementation backed by `ExAws.S3`.

- [Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Adapters.AWS.HTTPClient](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Adapters.AWS.HTTPClient.md): ExAws HTTP client implementation backed by Req.
- [Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Adapters.GCS](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Adapters.GCS.md): Google Cloud Storage-backed document storage adapter.

- [Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Adapters.GCS.Client](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Adapters.GCS.Client.md): Behaviour for the GCS storage adapter's Google API client boundary.

- [Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Adapters.GCS.GoogleApiClient](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Adapters.GCS.GoogleApiClient.md): Default GCS client implementation backed by `google_api_storage` and `Goth`.

- [Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Adapters.Local](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Adapters.Local.md): Local filesystem adapter for document storage.

- [Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Behaviour](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Interfaces.Storage.Behaviour.md): Behaviour for external document storage adapters.

- [Aludel.LLM](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.LLM.md): LLM client abstraction for multi-provider support.
- [Aludel.Projects](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Projects.md): Context for managing projects that organize prompts and test suites.

- [Aludel.Projects.Project](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Projects.Project.md): Schema for organizing prompts and test suites into projects.

- [Aludel.Prompts](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Prompts.md): Context for managing prompts and their versions.

- [Aludel.Prompts.Evolution](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Prompts.Evolution.md): Functions for analyzing prompt version evolution and performance
metrics.

- [Aludel.Prompts.Evolution.Export](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Prompts.Evolution.Export.md): Export serialization for prompt evolution metrics.

- [Aludel.Prompts.Prompt](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Prompts.Prompt.md): Schema for managing prompts.
- [Aludel.Prompts.PromptVersion](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Prompts.PromptVersion.md): Schema for prompt versions.
- [Aludel.Providers](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Providers.md): Context for managing AI provider configurations.

- [Aludel.Providers.Pricing](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Providers.Pricing.md): Resolves pricing for a given provider and model.
- [Aludel.Providers.Provider](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Providers.Provider.md): Schema for AI provider configurations.

- [Aludel.Repo](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Repo.md): Central repository accessor for Aludel.
- [Aludel.Runs](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Runs.md): Context for managing runs and run results.

- [Aludel.Runs.Execution](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Runs.Execution.md): Result of executing a run across one or more providers.

- [Aludel.Runs.Executor](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Runs.Executor.md): Owns run launch and provider execution under explicit supervision.

- [Aludel.Runs.Run](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Runs.Run.md): Schema for managing runs.
- [Aludel.Runs.RunResult](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Runs.RunResult.md): Schema for run results.
- [Aludel.Stats.Activity](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Stats.Activity.md): Recent activity feeds and time-series activity reporting.

- [Aludel.Stats.Costs](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Stats.Costs.md): Cost reporting and breakdowns for the dashboard.

- [Aludel.Stats.Latency](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Stats.Latency.md): Latency reporting and provider breakdowns.

- [Aludel.Stats.Overview](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Stats.Overview.md): Top-line dashboard metrics and period comparisons.

- [Aludel.Storage](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Storage.md): Domain-facing facade for document storage backends.
- [Aludel.Web.Assets](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Web.Assets.md): Serves pre-compiled static assets for Aludel dashboard.
- [Aludel.Web.Authentication](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Web.Authentication.md): LiveView on_mount hook for Aludel dashboard authentication.

- [Aludel.Web.CoreComponents](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Web.CoreComponents.md): Provides core UI components.
- [Aludel.Web.Hooks](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Web.Hooks.md): LiveView hooks for common functionality across all LiveViews.

- [Aludel.Web.Resolver](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Web.Resolver.md): Behavior for customizing dashboard access and user identification.
- [Aludel.Web.Router](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Aludel.Web.Router.md): Provides the aludel_dashboard macro for mounting Aludel in host apps.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix aludel.install](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Aludel.Install.md): Installs Aludel by copying migrations to the host application.
- [mix aludel.seed](https://aludel.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Aludel.Seed.md): Runs Aludel seed data.
